description_en: Queries the AI investigation details of a specified incident, including the report ID, investigation time, judgment category, summary, conclusion, and report content
description_zh: 查询指定事件的 AI 调查详情，包括报告标识、调查时间、研判分类、摘要、结论和报告内容
name: GetIncidentInvestigation

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center resides. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID that the administrator uses to switch to the view of another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The globally unique identity of the event. If neither the report ID nor the display ID is specified, the most recent successfully completed investigation result for this event is returned via event query
parameters.help_zh: 事件的全局唯一标识。未指定报告 ID 和显示 ID 时，按该事件查询最近一次成功完成的调查结果
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en: The AI investigation report ID. You can obtain this value from the IncidentInvestigationId field returned by ListIncidentInvestigations. If both this parameter and IncidentInvestigationDisplayId are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: AI 调查报告 ID，可从 ListIncidentInvestigations 返回的 IncidentInvestigationId 获取。与 IncidentInvestigationDisplayId 同时传入时，优先使用本参数
parameters.name: incident_investigation_id

parameters.help_en: The display ID of the AI investigation report. You can obtain this value from the IncidentInvestigationDisplayId field returned by ListIncidentInvestigations. This parameter takes effect only when IncidentInvestigationId is not specified. If neither identifier is specified, the most recent successfully completed investigation result for the specified incident is returned
parameters.help_zh: AI 调查报告的显示 ID，可从 ListIncidentInvestigations 返回的 IncidentInvestigationDisplayId 获取。仅在未传入 IncidentInvestigationId 时生效；两个标识都不传时，查询指定事件最近一次成功完成的调查结果
parameters.name: incident_investigation_display_id

schema.description_en: The data returned by the request

IncidentInvestigation.description_en: The AI investigation details of the incident. This field is empty if no matching investigation record is found
IncidentInvestigation.description_zh: 事件的 AI 调查详情。未找到匹配的调查记录时为空

IncidentInvestigationAlertName.description_en: The name of the alert that triggered this AI investigation
IncidentInvestigationAlertName.description_zh: 触发本次 AI 调查的告警名称

IncidentInvestigationConclusion.description_en: The judgment conclusion of the AI investigation, corresponding to ai_judgement_conclusion in the report
IncidentInvestigationConclusion.description_zh: AI 调查的研判结论，对应报告中的 ai_judgement_conclusion
IncidentInvestigationConclusion.example: 现有证据不足，无法确认攻击链是否完整，建议补充关联日志后进一步分析。

IncidentInvestigationDisplayId.description_en: The display ID of the AI investigation report. You can use this value as the IncidentInvestigationDisplayId parameter of this operation to query the report
IncidentInvestigationDisplayId.description_zh: AI 调查报告的显示 ID，可作为本接口的 IncidentInvestigationDisplayId 入参查询该报告

IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_en: The end time of the AI investigation, in seconds (UNIX timestamp). If the execution end time is not recorded, the last update time of the investigation record is used. This field is empty if neither time exists
IncidentInvestigationEndTime.description_zh: AI 调查结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。未记录执行结束时间时，使用调查记录的最后更新时间；两者都不存在时为空

IncidentInvestigationId.description_en: The unique ID of the AI investigation report. You can use this value as the IncidentInvestigationId parameter of this operation to query the report
IncidentInvestigationId.description_zh: AI 调查报告的唯一 ID，可作为本接口的 IncidentInvestigationId 入参查询该报告

IncidentInvestigationOutput.description_en: The output content of the AI investigation, in JSON-formatted string. This field can contain fields such as investigation_report (the investigation process and evidence body, which may use Markdown format). This field is empty if the corresponding output is not generated. Internal fields may change across report versions
IncidentInvestigationOutput.description_zh: AI 调查的输出内容，采用 JSON 格式的字符串。可包含 investigation_report（调查过程与证据正文，其内容可使用 Markdown 格式）等字段；未生成对应输出时为空，内部字段随报告版本变化
IncidentInvestigationOutput.example: {"investigation_report":"### 调查结果\n检测到可疑文件，尚缺少执行证据。"}

IncidentInvestigationReport.description_en: The AI investigation report content, in JSON-formatted string. This field can contain fields such as judgement_category (judgment category), ai_judgement_conclusion (judgment conclusion), ai_summary (summary), attack process, and attack graph. The specific content may change across report versions
IncidentInvestigationReport.description_zh: AI 调查报告内容，采用 JSON 格式的字符串。可包含 judgement_category（研判分类）、ai_judgement_conclusion（研判结论）、ai_summary（摘要）以及攻击过程、攻击图谱等字段；具体内容随报告版本变化
IncidentInvestigationReport.example: {"judgement_category":"insufficient_information_to_evaluate","ai_judgement_conclusion":"现有证据不足，无法确认攻击链是否完整，建议补充关联日志后进一步分析。","ai_summary":"检测到可疑文件，现有证据不足以确认攻击是否成功。"}

IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_en: The start time of the AI investigation, in seconds (UNIX timestamp). If the execution start time is not recorded, the creation time of the investigation record is used. This field is empty if neither time exists
IncidentInvestigationStartTime.description_zh: AI 调查开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。未记录执行开始时间时，使用调查记录的创建时间；两者都不存在时为空

IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_en:
The judgment category of the AI investigation report, corresponding to judgement_category in the report. This field does not indicate the execution status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:
real_attack: Real attack.
blocked: Risk blocked.
false_positive: Suspected false positive.
insufficient_information_to_evaluate: Unable to determine
IncidentInvestigationStatus.description_zh:
AI 调查报告的研判分类，对应报告中的 judgement_category，不表示异步任务的执行状态。取值：
real_attack：真实攻击。
blocked：风险阻断。
false_positive：疑似误报。
insufficient_information_to_evaluate：无法研判

IncidentInvestigationSummary.description_en: The summary of the AI investigation report, corresponding to ai_summary in the investigation results
IncidentInvestigationSummary.description_zh: AI 调查报告的摘要，对应调查结果中的 ai_summary
IncidentInvestigationSummary.example: 检测到可疑文件，现有证据不足以确认攻击是否成功。

IncidentUuid.description_en: The globally unique UUID of the incident

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用
